description: Clipboard text-to-speech desktop app with AI voice generation and browser integration.
pre_install: if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $payload -PathType Leaf)) { throw 'CopySpeech application payload was not found in the NSIS package.' }
if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $mainExe -PathType Leaf)) { throw 'CopySpeech.exe was not found after extracting the nested application archive.' }
notes: Uses the official Tauri NSIS setup as an extraction container; Scoop does not run the vendor installer. CopySpeech includes an in-app updater, so use Scoop as the update authority to avoid competing updates.
